decision: Qualify TQP-32 for the retained bounded Windows native chunk, finite-world boundary, outside-field sampling, enclosure, unloaded-neighbor, and catalog policy without widening the claim to general topology or dynamic terrain.
alternatives_considered: treat the resident chunk set as the field domain and synthesize air for missing neighbors
hide exterior cracks with skirts or overlapping geometry
defer all boundary ownership until dynamic streaming work
qualify a bounded total sample-source policy before independent general topology oracles
evidence: four retained two-by-two-by-two LOD0 and LOD2 windows with 64 cold/warm direct WorldTransvoxelCellProbe chunk calls
closed all-face volume and closed capped terrain with zero exterior, interior-open, or nonmanifold edges
intentionally open terrain with 142 open edges confined to declared exterior planes and no interior openings
6,936 native gradient-halo samples outside each fixture domain, evenly covering all six directions
five direct native LOD2 unloaded-neighbor calls proving resident-target signature invariance and exact loaded interface agreement
twelve injected controls for invalid catalogs, residency, skirts, overlap, and resident-dependent density
qualified_scope: native LOD0 and LOD2 internal same-resolution interfaces in the retained finite windows
total authoritative density/material sampling through the native gradient halo
density-field-owned closed enclosure, side/bottom terrain caps, and declared open exterior contours
resident chunk geometry independence from same-LOD neighbor residency
exact bounded eight-chunk catalog and bounded partial-residency rejection policy
explicit rejection of artificial skirts, hidden overlap, and resident fallback density
unqualified_scope: general independent geometry/topology oracles and arbitrary injected mesh defects reserved for TQP-33
randomized or adversarial field corpora reserved for TQP-34
dynamic asynchronous LOD publication, streaming, edits, rendering, collision, navigation, and persistence
catalog sizes beyond the retained policy fixture
production performance, other platforms, and other native build profiles
review: Focused native fixtures, cold/warm determinism, internal seam equality, declared contour classification, total halo sampling, catalog rejection, residency invariance, injected controls, retained evidence validation, and editor capture inspection passed. The capture is diagnostic support rather than a visual-quality acceptance gate.
downstream_impact: TQP-33 becomes the next dependency-ordered milestone. Gate E remains closed, and dynamic adaptive terrain, destruction promotion, GPU authority, and production claims remain frozen. No world-transvoxel source or binary change was required.
